mapper.select: SELECT account_id, preferred_currency, channel_sms, channel_email, channel_in_app, notify_order_status, notify_watchlist_alerts, date_format, time_format, number_format, ai_assistant_enabled, theme, landing_page, default_order_type, updated_at FROM customer_preference WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_preference ( account_id, preferred_currency, channel_sms, channel_email, channel_in_app, notify_order_status, notify_watchlist_alerts, date_format, time_format, number_format, ai_assistant_enabled, theme, landing_page, default_order_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.accountId}, #{row.preferredCurrency}, #{row.channelSms}, #{row.channelEmail}, #{row.channelInApp}, #{row.notifyOrderStatus}, #{row.notifyWatchlistAlerts}, #{row.dateFormat}, #{row.timeFormat}, #{row.numberFormat}, #{row.aiAssistantEnabled}, #{row.theme}, #{row.landingPage}, #{row.defaultOrderType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET preferred_currency = EXCLUDED.preferred_currency, channel_sms = EXCLUDED.channel_sms, channel_email = EXCLUDED.channel_email, channel_in_app = EXCLUDED.channel_in_app, notify_order_status = EXCLUDED.notify_order_status, notify_watchlist_alerts = EXCLUDED.notify_watchlist_alerts, date_format = EXCLUDED.date_format, time_format = EXCLUDED.time_format, number_format = EXCLUDED.number_format, ai_assistant_enabled = EXCLUDED.ai_assistant_enabled, theme = EXCLUDED.theme, landing_page = EXCLUDED.landing_page, default_order_type = EXCLUDED.default_order_type, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
